kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أحتشد (form VIII)
# أَحْتَشِدُ (ʔaḥtašidu) /ʔaħ.ta.ʃi.du/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِحْتَشَدَ (iḥtašada)
# أَحْتَشِدَ (ʔaḥtašida) /ʔaħ.ta.ʃi.da/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِحْتَشَدَ (iḥtašada)
# أَحْتَشِدْ (ʔaḥtašid) /ʔaħ.ta.ʃid/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِحْتَشَدَ (iḥtašada)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
